messages:
liz: quick design q  compact roles matrix mock: should SSO be an inline switch or a small status chip that opens a confirm popover? figma link pasted.
raj: chip for scan, but make it interactive. clicking opens quick confirm with affected users count.
noah: if chip opens popover, ensure keyboard focus lands inside and chip uses <button aria-pressed>. popover must close on Esc.
emma: contrast on the chip text fails current spec (3.0:1). need stronger color or larger type. tooltip must appear on focus too.
liz: copy thought: visible label "SSO enforced"; popover aria-label "Require single sign-on for [role name]". full modal for bulk ops listing per-role affected users.
raj: product: when toggling on, modal should warn "X users do not have SSO and will be prevented from signing in" and include link "View affected users" + checkbox "I understand". also deep-link to audit log entry.
noah: eng: deep-link format request: /audit?role_id=<id>&action=ssotoggle&event=<ts>. audit page should focus and announce opened entry; fallback to filtered list with toast.
emma: accessibility checklist: chip -> button + aria-pressed, popover focus trap, aria-describedby on modal linking user list, contrast fix, tooltips on focus. schedule re-scan after updated mock.
liz: action items: 1) design to update chip color & add popover + modal flows (i'll update figma). 2) product to finalize modal copy and deep-link spec (raj). 3) eng to implement button semantics and focus behavior (noah). 4) a11y to re-scan (emma).
ops-bot: reminder: attach rollout checklist to PR for any change that affects auth flow.
raj: quick vote: +1 chip + confirm modal, prefer not hiding SSO behind overflow.
noah: +1 for button semantics and explicit modal for bulk.
emma: +1 if contrast and focus behavior fixed.
liz: thanks all  i'll post updated mocks when ready :thumbsup:
